description: One-liner is now fully hands-free: install.py --run attempts the Tailscale public link automatically (auto-installing Tailscale on Linux when missing) instead of prompting, the final report is exactly three lines (Web Server Local/Public + Server Running Now), the --run server-start crash is fixed, and project/x5agent start runs the console directly with no update check.
features: Fixed install.py --run crash at server takeover (port passed as int to os.execv).
install.py --run is now fully automatic: public link attempted without prompting (auto-installs Tailscale on Linux when missing, best-effort); --no-public still skips it.
Final report is now three lines only: Web Server (Local) / Web Server (Public) / Server Running Now.
New project/x5agent starter: ./x5agent start [--public] runs the console on 0.0.0.0:7777 with no update check.
Version synced to 0.9.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
